items.prompt: Two angles in a triangle are 47° and 68°. What is the third angle in degrees?
hints: The angles in a triangle add up to 180°.

items.prompt: Four angles meet at a point: 90°, 120°, 2x and x + 30. All the angles are in degrees. What is x?
hints: Angles around a point add up to 360°.
Add the numbers and the x terms separately.

items.prompt: Three angles of a quadrilateral are 85°, 110° and 70°. What is the fourth angle?
hints: A quadrilateral has angles that add up to 360°.

options.why: Check your sum. The angles of a quadrilateral add up to 360°.
This is the total of the three angles. The fourth angle is what is missing from 360°.
You may have copied the first angle. Subtract the three angles from 360°.

items.prompt: True or false: The angles around a point add up to 360 degrees.
hints: How many degrees are in a full turn?

items.prompt: True or false: The angles in a quadrilateral add up to 180 degrees.
hints: How many triangles do you get?
items.explanation: A quadrilateral can be split into 2 triangles, so its angles add up to 2 × 180 = 360 degrees.

items.prompt: True or false: In a triangle with angles of 70 degrees and 50 degrees, the third angle is 60 degrees.
Angles on a straight line: 120° and ?°
hints: Angles on a line add to 180°.
items.explanation: Angles on a straight line total 180°, so 180 - 120 = 60.
